title: VAE Diagwerk health report, version 1
description: The health report VAE Diagwerk for Motorrad exports as JSON. GUIDE.md in this repository says how to read it. Unknown keys are allowed everywhere: later app versions may add some without changing the version.

schema.description: Names the layout. The number goes up when a key is removed or changes its meaning.

guide.description: The address of the guide to this file.

about.description: One sentence on what the file is.

app.description: The app and version that made the report. Ends in " (demo)" for the app's simulated vehicle.

readAt.description: When the vehicle was read: ISO 8601, UTC, to the second.

details.description: Model, Year, Odometer and VIN. A value the app could not learn reads "Unknown".

note.description: Beside Model, the type key and series code ("0J93 · K50"); beside Year, the production month.

modules.description: How many modules the report lists.

modulesNotRead.description: How many of them have faultMemoryRead false. Not 0: the fault counts are incomplete.

options.description: The vehicle order's option codes. Left out when the vehicle order was not read.

description.description: Left out when the app has no name for the code.

listedBy.description: On an option only some modules' copies of the vehicle order list: which.

controlUnit.description: BMW's name for the module variant and its diagnostic address.

status.description: The module's fault count as text.

faultMemoryRead.description: False: the module's faults are unknown (see note), and there is no faults key.

note.description: Why the fault memory was not read.

flag.description: "Differs" on a module VIN that is not the vehicle's.

usageStatistic.description: Present and true on a value that says how the vehicle was ridden.

fscEntitlements.description: The enabling codes (FSC) in force in this module. Left out when there are none.

name.description: BMW's name for the feature. Left out when unknown.

faults.description: Present, possibly empty, only when faultMemoryRead is true.

code.description: BMW fault code: six hex digits.

description.description: Left out when the app has no text for the code.

area.description: The function group and, for a network fault, the sender of the missing message.

occurred.description: One line: OBD code, mileage (or first–latest), occurrence count; each when known.

details.description: The fault's counters by name: OBD code, Occurrences, Healing counter, Fault class, Warning light.

snapshots.description: The records the module saved when the fault occurred. Left out when there are none in the report.

readings.description: Reading name to its value when the record was saved.
